title: Averaging against a normalized nonnegative kernel preserves the Lipschitz constant
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, K ≥ 0 (K ∈ ℝ≥0) and ψ, g : ℝ^P → ℝ, where ℝ^P = Euclid P carries Lebesgue measure λ. Suppose ψ is continuous, has compact support, ψ(x) ≥ 0 for every x and ∫ ψ dλ = 1, and g is K-Lipschitz. Then the function x ↦ ∫ ψ(y)·g(x − y) dλ(y) is K-Lipschitz on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ψ g : Euclid P → ℝ) (K : NNReal), Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) → ∫ x, ψ x = 1 → LipschitzWith K g → LipschitzWith K (fun x => ∫ y, ψ y * g (x - y))
